snippet.title: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition is available now on Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S. Watch the Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition launch trailer to see chaotic gameplay from this strategy game remaster of the 1999 classic. Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition features enhancements, quality-of-life improvements, and a UI redesign across all platform versions. Other features include online support, allowing up to six players to team-up or compete. Online is cross-generation so PS4 and PS5 owners will be able to play against each other, as well Xbox One and Xbox Series owners.
